old_problem: The active record left the case pending because versions, all-port identity, traffic profile and BER disposition were not yet project-bound. These are execution prerequisites, not an unresolved command semantic: NVIDIA documents that --reset_phy_info clears all-port PHY information, recommends pairing it with --pc, and that --get_phy_info obtains all-port PHY/BER data and writes diagnostic outputs.
disposition_reason: The vendor-defined reset/get sequence supplies the authoritative command semantics and built-in Symbol/Effective BER checks. ED-03 permits release and fabric identities as runtime bindings; ED-05 preserves IB-only scope; ED-14 requires the complete source duration; ED-15 forbids PASS without the applicable built-in check and project major-warning policy; ED-17 requires pre-reset evidence preservation. The review is therefore complete while execution remains gated by approved scope and parameters.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row426 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3017 and adjacent row425 telemetry plus row427 Topodiff cases.

Applied NVIDIA ibdiagnet semantics: --reset_phy_info queries then clears PHY information for all ports, --pc is recommended with the reset, and --get_phy_info queries all ports including BER and produces diagnostic outputs.
Preserved the source's all-port --pc/--reset_phy_info then --get_phy_info workflow and selected the complete 15-minute upper-bound interval rather than shortening the stated 10-15-minute coverage.
Required a pre-reset export, exact generated-command preview and immutable output bundle so a clean post-reset result cannot conceal erased history.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row427 and verified its manifest identity; no traffic, PHY reset, diagnostic query or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: All-port UFM IBDiagnet PHY reset epoch and Symbol/Effective BER validation under bounded IB traffic
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved active InfiniBand port accumulates a fresh, traffic-exercised PHY interval and passes the release-applicable ibdiagnet Symbol/Effective BER and major-error checks without losing the pre-test diagnostic history.
required_package: Approved UFM and ibdiagnet release with captured help/version output and generated command preview
Authoritative fabric GUID/port/cable inventory and explicit all-port inclusion/exclusion list
Pinned finite ib_write_bw endpoint/profile for the complete 900-second measurement interval with watchdog
Release-applicable built-in Symbol/Effective BER checks plus project-approved major-warning and unavailable-port disposition
Writable, capacity-checked evidence path and synchronized timestamps
test_case.test_command: Record versions, fabric inventory, idle health and complete existing PHY/counter diagnostics. In the UFM IBDiagnet page preview and authorize the release-verified all-port command containing --pc and --reset_phy_info; start the bounded ib_write_bw workload and execute the reset action exactly once. Record the epoch timestamp, maintain the approved load for the full 900 seconds, then run the release-verified --get_phy_info action exactly once. Preserve the complete output directory including ibdiagnet2.log, database/CSV outputs and command/stdout/stderr, map every result to its approved port/cable, then stop traffic and capture post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The pre-reset archive is complete, the approved command resets only the intended all-port PHY epoch, the full 900-second workload completes on the mapped IB path, and the subsequent all-port query covers every required port. The release-applicable Symbol BER and Effective BER checks finish without errors, no project-defined major error remains, and fabric/link health is intact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the pre-reset archive, exact version/command/scope, complete 900-second traffic evidence, one reset and one post-interval query, complete ibdiagnet outputs, full required-port coverage, successful built-in Symbol/Effective BER checks, no unaccepted major error and healthy poststate. Missing port identity, output, built-in check or approved warning disposition is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Export all existing PHY/counter diagnostics before the reset and confirm the all-port scope at a user hold point
Use only the approved isolated IB fabric and finite 900-second traffic profile with external watchdog
Verify output capacity and timestamps; never clear SEL/system logs or other diagnostic history
Abort on unexpected link/fabric/routing/thermal/RAS impact, terminate traffic peers and never repeat the reset automatically
expected_evidence: UFM/ibdiagnet version/help, generated command preview and approved all-port identity map
Pre-reset PHY/counter archive with hashes and idle fabric health
Reset timestamp plus full 900-second ib_write_bw endpoint outputs and watchdog state
Post-interval --get_phy_info command/output and complete hashed output directory
Per-port Symbol/Effective BER and major-error table, exclusions, post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On traffic, reset-scope or diagnostic anomaly stop both traffic endpoints, preserve all pre/post evidence, verify every link and UFM service returns healthy and escalate any affected port using the archived identity map. Do not restore erased PHY history by fabrication, clear logs or retry the reset automatically.
